headline: Sensex and Nifty rally as Nifty Bank hits record high amid strong foreign fund inflows and moderate crude prices.

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Record foreign fund inflows are driving the November surge in Indian equities
A significant rally in the banking sector pushed the Nifty Bank index to record highs
Moderating crude oil prices have improved investor sentiment and reduced inflationary concerns
Positive global cues, including rising Nasdaq futures, supported the domestic market opening
whatHappening: Sensex and Nifty hit multi-month highs during a strong intraday rally
Nifty Bank reaches a new record level as banking stocks lead the market
Amazon announces a $7 billion investment in India's renewable energy sector by 2030
States' fiscal deficit is projected to ease to 2.9% of GDP in FY27
summary: Indian markets surged with the Sensex rising 427 points and Nifty Bank reaching a record high. The rally was supported by significant foreign fund inflows and declining crude oil prices. While indices hit multi-month highs, analysts suggest caution despite the current bullish momentum.
